sources.title: RLUSD is now available on Coinbase
claims: RLUSD is available through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase retail app in supported regions.
At launch, RLUSD deposits and withdrawals are supported across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Customers in supported regions can convert USD to RLUSD at 1:1.
Coinbase says RLUSD collateral use for Coinbase Global Exchange customers will follow later.
Coinbase says Ripple will provide liquidity on Base.
limitations: The announcement does not publish chain-specific customer balances, deposit/withdrawal volume or actual bridge transactions.
The announcement does not establish that the XRPL RLUSD supply decline was caused by Coinbase listing activity.
The stated Global Exchange collateral use was deferred at launch.

sources.title: RLUSD supply history — cross-chain treasury watch
claims: XRPL daily snapshot at 2026-10-30T01:00:00Z displayed approximately USD 981,760,000 RLUSD.
XRPL daily snapshot at 2026-10-31T01:00:00Z displayed USD 707,358,109.94 RLUSD, a derived daily change of -USD 274,401,890.06 or approximately -27.95%.
At page capture, the dashboard displayed approximately USD 1.71B on Ethereum and USD 707.36M on XRPL, approximately USD 2.42B combined across those two chains.
The rolling 24-hour panel displayed XRPL net supply change of -USD 67.60M, Ethereum mints of +USD 19.60M and combined Ethereum-plus-XRPL net change of -USD 48.00M.
The dashboard labels Base as testing and its stated supply scope is Ethereum plus XRPL, not Base.
limitations: The page reported its live feed unavailable during capture and warned that totals could be a few minutes stale.
The rolling 24-hour cross-check against independent RPC was dated 2026-10-30 finalized data, not a recomputation performed in this run.
The page publishes an Ed25519-signed daily snapshot, but this run did not independently recompute its signature.
The XRPL net supply-change method uses gateway_balances day-boundary snapshot differences; the page does not provide a transaction-level bridge/redemption crosswalk for this observation.
The daily snapshot difference and rolling 24-hour change are different windows and must not be substituted for one another.

sources.title: RLUSD supply methodology and scope
claims: Ethereum supply is read from totalSupply; XRPL supply is read from gateway_balances at UTC-day-boundary ledgers.
The dashboard describes XRPL supply change as net mints minus redemptions and does not separately enumerate all underlying transactions in this view.
The displayed two-chain total excludes Base, which the page labels testing.
limitations: This methodology disclosure is from the same provider and is not an independent corroborating source.
A supply change alone does not distinguish cross-chain migration, issuer redemption, holder transfers or provider-scope changes.

sources.title: XRP exchange balances — October 31, 2026 08:00 UTC
claims: The page reports 22.48B XRP in 701 XRPL wallets attributed to 24 exchanges as of 2026-10-31 08:00 UTC.
Same-wallet aggregate changes are -133.0M XRP over seven days and -12.3M XRP over 30 days.
Attributed balances are Upbit 6.43B XRP, Coinbase 5.85B XRP, Binance 2.78B XRP and SBI VC Trade 59.5M XRP.
The current page reports Coinbase +17.7M XRP over seven days and +18.4M over 30 days; Binance +17.6M and +30.3M; Upbit -747K and +34.6M; SBI VC Trade -899K and -10.5M, respectively.
The page reports 487.2M XRP in non-customer reserve/operational wallets: 325.8M Binance-Peg backing, 150.2M cbXRP backing and 11.2M in an insurance fund/charity wallet.
The naive total change is +2.15B XRP because 22 newly tracked wallets holding 2.17B XRP were added; the same-wallet method excludes new wallets.
limitations: Wallet balances are not tradable float: exchange wallets include customer omnibus custody, cold storage, wrapped-asset backing and operational funds.
The provider uses XRPL rippled account_info balances and XRPSCAN public labels; it does not identify beneficial owners or whether balances are offered for sale.
The page notes incomplete exchange coverage and that same-wallet changes cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from internal migration to untracked wallets.

A prior 2026-10-31 17:57 UTC source capture recorded different 30-day and venue-specific changes. Preserve both captures; the current page display supersedes the prior displayed values for the current observation, but the cause of the revision is unknown.

sources.title: Exchange-balance methodology and coverage limitations
claims: The provider says it reads each tracked wallet's balance directly from rippled account_info once daily at approximately 08:00 UTC.
Wallet attribution uses XRPSCAN public account labels; the provider stores daily exchange totals and wallet counts.
The page says 48.4% of its tracked exchange XRP is in wallets labeled cold and 37.8% is unlabeled as hot or cold.
The provider explicitly states that its attributed-wallet total is not an estimate of tradable float.
limitations: The methodology is disclosed by the same provider and is not an independent wallet-label audit.
Cold/hot labels are incomplete and do not establish beneficial ownership or sale availability.
